principle: Failure to locate a primary-source report is not converted into a negative existence label.

resolved_entries.label: SUPPORTED_STOICHIOMETRIC_SOLID
resolved_entries.evidence: X-ray crystal structure; solid formulated as [PBr4]+ Br- rather than a trigonal-bipyramidal neutral molecule.

resolved_entries.label: SUPPORTED_STOICHIOMETRIC_COMPOUND
resolved_entries.evidence: Primary literature reports arsenic pentachloride; later solid-state work resolves a trigonal-bipyramidal structure.

resolved_entries.label: SUPPORTED_BUT_THERMALLY_UNSTABLE_AND_REPRODUCIBILITY_SENSITIVE
resolved_entries.evidence: Primary experimental literature treats reported SCl4 as thermally unstable; a later study states its reported synthesis could not be reproduced. 2026 electrochemical work independently supports reversible S/SCl4 chemistry in situ.

resolved_entries.label: SUPPORTED_STOICHIOMETRIC_SOLID
resolved_entries.evidence: Experimental solid-state studies show SeCl4 stoichiometry with ionic/tetrameric organization rather than a simple isolated EX4 molecule.

resolved_entries.label: SUPPORTED_STOICHIOMETRIC_SPECIES_IN_SOLUTION_STUDIES
resolved_entries.evidence: Primary spectrophotometric and solution studies explicitly investigate selenium tetrabromide and its dissociation/speciation.

negative_evidence_not_promoted_to_false.evidence: One primary synthetic study states SBr4 was synthetically inaccessible in that work.
negative_evidence_not_promoted_to_false.label: UNRESOLVED_NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE_ONLY

score.interpretation: Resolved labels are all positives predicted by both models, so the panel does not discriminate M1 from M0. Missing-report searches cannot supply reliable negative labels.
